title: Reto Sistema Bancario
description: A banking backend with independent client and account microservices, deposits, withdrawals, and balance validation.
imageAlt: Client and account microservices linked through RabbitMQ, with separate PostgreSQL databases.
capabilities: Manage clients, accounts, and transactions; generate account statements by client and date range.
Validate available balances before debit operations and exchange events through RabbitMQ.
Reactive persistence with R2DBC, versioned migrations with Flyway, and automated tests.

title: La Pinguinera
description: A bookstore quotation system that applies customer and volume pricing rules, with a reactive backend and a connected frontend.
imageAlt: Angular frontend connects to a .NET quotation domain with pricing rules and MongoDB event persistence.
capabilities: Calculate individual, list, budget, and group quotes with customer-seniority and quantity-based pricing rules.
Keep domain rules separate using DDD and Hexagonal Architecture, with reactive use cases and controllers.
Persist domain events in MongoDB with Event Sourcing; connect an Angular frontend using NgRx.

title: ToDo App & API
description: A complete task-management solution: a React interface backed by an Express API for organizing tasks and categories.
imageAlt: React and Redux task interface connects through an Express API to MongoDB.
capabilities: Create, edit, and delete tasks and categories through the frontend and REST API.
Manage client state with Redux and use TypeScript across the interface and API.
Store tasks and categories in MongoDB through Mongoose.
